title: The Salt Compass
author: C. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Tamsin Okafor, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
